_comment: PROPOSAL — 3D general arrangement of the ship, fitted to the sim's room graph (ship.json). Frame: metres; x fore(+)/aft(−), y starboard(+)/port(−), z up(+); origin amidships on the main-deck floor. Each room is a box. Its local coordinate u (the axis the side-on camera sees as left→right) is given by axis + origin: '+x' u = x − origin, '−x' u = origin − x, '+y' u = y − origin, '−y' u = origin − y. 'view' is the wall the room camera faces (its back wall). Hatches give the 3D door point (or a short path for crawlways); tools/ship3d.mjs checks them against ship.json.
name: Halyard-class long-range surveyor
summary: A 94 m, single-occupant survey hull. A low arrowhead main hull carries fuel, reactor, frame-shift drive and engines; a dorsal 'head' superstructure forward holds the living deck and the bridge under a wraparound canopy.

rooms.info: Forward on the upper deck, under the wraparound canopy. Helm, nav, scanner and terminal face the glazing; the camera looks forward across them.
Spine of the living deck. Quarters and galley open to starboard, lounge and washroom to port, the bridge at the forward end and the companionway down at the aft end.
Starboard, forward. Bunk, basin, desk, locker and the torpor pod, with a viewport out to starboard.
Starboard, aft of the quarters. Pantry, stove, counter and a table by a small starboard viewport.
Port side, behind the largest window on the ship. Couch, easel, speaker and room to exercise.

rooms.name: Washroom (head)
rooms.info: Small washroom between the lounge and the companionway.

rooms.resize: lengthened from 14 m to 20 m so the six service compartments can open off it
rooms.info: Service spine on the main deck, from the foot of the companionway to the engineering bulkhead. Six compartments open off it.
Starboard, the longest compartment: ten grow trays, the algae tank, the seed bank and two pumps. The plumbing crawlway leaves from its aft end.
Starboard, aft. Bench, fabricator and lathe, with a side door straight into engineering.
Port, forward of the airlock. Shelves and crates of spares, feedstock and food.
Port, amidships. Inner door from the corridor, suit rack, and the outer door onto the EVA lift well.
Port, aft. Water recycler, oxygen generator, CO₂ scrubber and dehumidifier.
Full-beam compartment at the aft end of the pressurized decks. Its camera looks aft at the shadow-shield bulkhead: scoop manifold to starboard, reactor face on the centreline, drive coupling to port.

hatches.note: ladder well and pressure hatch between the decks
service crawlway under the corridor deck, carrying the water mains

canopy.note: wraparound glazing over the bridge: forward and roof panels

modules.name: Fuel tank (port)
modules.info: Liquid hydrogen, 16 t. Fed by the scoop manifold; burned by reactor and drive.

modules.name: Fusion reactor
modules.info: 40 kW-class plant. Its forward face and coolant loop are what engineering sees through the aft bulkhead.

modules.name: Shadow shield bulkhead
modules.info: Radiation shield between the reactor and the pressurized decks.

modules.name: Frame-shift drive
modules.info: Hyperspace coil assembly. Wears with each jump.

modules.name: Main drive block
modules.info: Thruster feed, gimbals and the supercruise field generator.

modules.name: Radiator panels (port)
modules.info: Dorsal radiators. Glow on the hull camera when the ship runs hot.

modules.name: Fuel scoop intake
modules.info: Chin intake. Plasma is drawn in here while skimming a star.

modules.name: Cargo & sample hold
modules.info: Unpressurized. Ore and ice samples wait here to be refined.

modules.name: EVA lift well
modules.info: The airlock's outer door opens onto a lift platform that lowers to the surface.

modules.name: Sensor mast & nav beacon
modules.info: Long-range sensor array. Seen from the hull camera with its blinking beacon.
